hook: 5 things that fixed my sleep and cost me nothing
caption: Ranked by how much they moved the number, not by how good they sound.
notes: One item per slide. Longer deck, but swipe-through is what the algorithm reads.

slides.text: 5 things that fixed my sleep and cost me nothing
slides.sub: (i wasted about £400 on supplements before any of these)
Same alarm on Saturday. This did more than everything else combined.
Your core temperature has to fall for you to fall asleep.
Ten minutes outside beats any lamp you'll buy.
Late eating showed up as more wake events every single time.
Not because coffee is bad. Because its half life is six hours.

slides.text: Four of these did nothing for a friend of mine.
slides.sub: Population advice is a starting guess, not an answer.

slides.text: The only result that counts is yours.
